description: This file defines the GlooDeviceFactory class in the c10d namespace, providing static methods to create Gloo transport devices for specific interfaces or hostnames. It also declares a shared registry for Gloo devices.
external_methods: gloo::transport::Device's constructor or static methods (implied by usage)

classes.name: GlooDeviceFactory
classes.description: A factory class with static methods to create Gloo transport devices for specific network interfaces or hostnames.

methods.name: makeDeviceForInterface
methods.description: Creates a new Gloo transport device for a given network interface, with optional lazy initialization.

methods.name: makeDeviceForHostname
methods.description: Creates a new Gloo transport device for a specified hostname or address, with optional lazy initialization.
